pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Medium-sized polygonal dark regions with sub-rounded vertices on the flank. Patches on the lower neck are larger and more irregularly elongated. Edge gradients show a smooth pixel transition between dark and light regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-toned pathways with consistent pixel width across the mid-flank. Topological nodes are clearly defined, primarily consisting of trivalent (Y-shaped) junctions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette along the dorsal neck and shoulder ridge, indicating short, dense hair growth.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinctive cluster of three parallel-curved dark bands on the upper dorsal flank that merge into a single larger patch at the lateral transition point.
